text:
Laila (CS): AuroraGrid renewal check-in — customer wants to shorten to a 9mo term in exchange for a 15% discount and is asking to pay via a blanket PO. They also note the signer will be the EU subsidiary but remit-to should be AuroraGrid Inc (US). Can we accept this without an amendment? @Marco (AE) please confirm the ask.
Marco (AE): Customer wrote: "We can commit to 9 months with 15% off if you accept PO-7782 as payment instrument and bill to AuroraGrid Inc (US remit). Subsidiary will sign." Asking if we can do invoice to US entity while signature is EU subsidiary.
Priya (Legal): Two issues: 1) If the signing party is the EU subsidiary, the MSA/SOW needs to reflect that signatory or we need a POA linking signing authority to the US remit entity. 2) Pricing/term change is ok, but internal approval required for non-standard term <12mo. I'll need to review PO-7782 and the contract redline.
Tom (Finance): We can accept a blanket PO for invoicing, but we need the remit-to tax details and vendor code mapping. If they want the US entity as remit-to but EU signatory, we need a documented linkage (POA or corporate resolution). For the 15% discount, confirm whether they want upfront or monthly invoicing.
Erin (Onboarding): Onboarding depends on invoice/contract being in place. We can start kickoff workshops with limited access if they prepay the first invoice. Full SSO provisioning requires final invoice and billing entity mapped.
procurement-bot: Created purchase_order_review #PO-7782, assigned to @Tom (Finance) and @Priya (Legal). ETA 3 business days.
Laila (CS): Proposed flow: 1) Marco to request signed PO + remit details + tax id, 2) Customer to provide evidence linking EU signatory to US remit (POA or board resolution), 3) Priya to confirm whether POA suffices for signature authority, 4) Tom to accept PO once remit/tax details match, 5) Erin to prep onboarding timeline contingent on first invoice/payment. OK?
Marco (AE): I'll ask them to upload PO-7782 (PDF), remit-to W-9 (or UK/EU equivalent) and a POA if the signatory differs. Draft message: `Please attach PO-7782, remit-to tax docs for AuroraGrid Inc, and a POA or board resolution showing signing authority for the EU subsidiary. Confirm whether you want the 15% discounted amount invoice up front or monthly.`
Priya (Legal): Quick note — if the PO is dated after the effective date of the MSA/SOW we may need an amendment to reflect the shorter term. Also if the PO contains terms that conflict with our MSA, we'll need a conflict clause resolution. I'll review once documents are attached.
Tom (Finance): For pricing: if they want the 15% applied to the full 9mo up front, we can do an upfront invoice at discounted total; if they want monthly billing we'll do prorated monthly invoices at discounted rate. Wire preferred for PO payments, include PO number in remittance.
Erin (Onboarding): If they prepay first invoice or provide confirmed PO + W-9 and POA, I can schedule SSO onboarding for the week after payment clears. Otherwise we can provide sandbox access immediately.
Marco (AE): Customer responded: "Can provide PO & W-9 today, will try to get POA; prefer monthly invoicing at discounted rate."
Laila (CS): Action items recap: PO-7782 uploaded pending (Marco), W-9 incoming, POA pending, procurement-bot ticket created, Priya will review PO and POA when attached, Tom to confirm billing cadence once docs are verified, Erin to standby for provisioning. I'll update thread as items close. :spiral_calendar:
Priya (Legal): If POA arrives but is too generic, I may request a clause specifically authorizing commercial contract signing. Heads-up to Marco to ask customer to make POA explicit.
Tom (Finance): Marking this as "pending PO verification" on our side. Will not issue invoices until PO remit/tax lines are reconciled.
Laila (CS): Tracking summary: PO-7782 review open, W-9 expected, POA outstanding, onboarding contingent on remit verification or prepayment. Will follow up EOD. :white_check_mark:
